keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for an association, never coloured as territory (rule 4): the page names the member cities (Verona, Padua, Vicenza, Venice, Crema, Cremona, Mantua, Piacenza, Bergamo, Brescia, Genoa, Bologna, Milan, Modena, Reggio Emilia, Treviso, Vercelli, Lodi, Parma, Ferrara, some lords such as the Marquis Malaspina and Ezzelino da Romano) and says membership changed. It gives no infobox, no area and no territory. The region is a stand-in the renderer should use only for a membership tint or a caption, never as land of its own: the communes' own territories belong to eu-13 (Italy).

ledger.note: 1167: the oath of Pontida founds the Lombard League of northern Italian cities against Frederick Barbarossa. 'Formed according to tradition following the oath of Pontida on 7 April 1167'; the emperor had claimed direct control over Italy at the Diet of Roncaglia in 1158 and occupied and devastated Milan in 1162.

ledger.note: 1250: the League is dissolved with the death of Frederick II. 'The League was dissolved in 1250 when Frederick II died.' Frederick had won at Cortenuova in 1237, failed before Brescia in October 1238 and been excommunicated in 1239; the imperial camp at Parma was taken in 1248.

wars.outcome: The imperial army was defeated at Legnano on 29 May 1176; the Treaty of Venice (1177), a six-year truce from August 1178 and the Peace of Constance (1183) compromised.

wars.outcome: Frederick II won at Cortenuova in 1237, raised the siege of Brescia unsuccessfully in October 1238, was excommunicated in 1239 and lost his camp at Parma in the 1248 siege; the League dissolved in 1250 when he died.
wars.note: The page gives the 1226 date only as Frederick's plan to convene the princes in Italy; the war is dated by its events 1237-1248.

notes: One page opened (budget 1-2). An umbrella: the dossier carries the association, its dates and wars only; no land should be coloured from it. The page has no infobox and no territory; the whole-region stand-in is coarse (the League's real land was its members' contadi, held by the communes, eu-13). Not settled: whether the League of 1226 was a re-founded second league (the page does not say so); membership by date; the 1183 end of the first league. Gazetteer names used: Lombardia, Veneto, Emilia-Romagna (Natural Earth provinces and regions).
